CMA_Lemartec.parties: Inter Miami Stadium, LLC (Owner) vs Lemartec Corporation (CM)
CMA_Lemartec.scope: Full executive leadership, supervision, CM services for new Inter Miami CF MLS Stadium. CM acts as Owner's agent managing Trade Contractors retained directly by Owner.
CMA_Lemartec.amount: 2.95% Fee Rate on total construction costs (1.5% on OFOI). Insurance Costs: $87,207 lump sum. Owner's Contingency: $15,500,000. No GMP.
CMA_Lemartec.ld: NONE — No liquidated damages provision found
CMA_Lemartec.warranty: CM causes all Trade Contractors to provide 1-year warranty from TCO. CM assigns all warranties to Owner.
CMA_Lemartec.retainage: 10% on CM's Fee until 50% complete, then 0%. No retainage on GC/GR/Insurance costs.
CMA_Lemartec.insurance: OCIP covers enrolled Trade Contractors. CM maintains own: CGL $1M/$2M, Auto $1M, WC stat, Excess $5M, Prof Liab $1M, Cyber $2M.
CMA_Lemartec.indemnification: CM indemnifies for claims from gross negligence/willful misconduct/violation of law. NOT for Indemnitees' own negligence. Florida Statue 725.06 compliant.
CMA_Lemartec.termination: For cause: 10 days notice, 10 day cure. For convenience: 10 days notice, paid for services + demob (excl severance). By CM: 20 business days after 10 business days non-payment.
CMA_Lemartec.waiver_consequential: MUTUAL. Includes lost profits, loss of use, financing, reputation, business interruption.
CMA_Lemartec.liability_cap: CM's aggregate liability capped at amount of CM's Fee paid (except insured risks).
CMA_Lemartec.dispute_resolution: Referenced to Supplemental Conditions (Exhibit F). AAA arbitration in Miami-Dade, Florida law.
notable: No performance bond required (Section 14.3)
No GMP — CM does not guarantee budget or schedule
CM NOT responsible for Trade Contractor acts/omissions
City of Miami has audit rights per Definitive Documents
MFP Builders, LLC acknowledged as Owner's agent
CMA_Lemartec.exhibits: A (Drawings), B (Schedule), C (Budget), D (Staffing/GC Costs), E (Site Diagram), F (Supplemental Conditions), G (Trade Contract Form), H (OCIP Manual)

MANICA.parties: Miami Freedom Park, LLC (Developer) vs MANICA Architecture, PA (Design Architect)
MANICA.scope: Overall design concept/aesthetic for MFP Stadium (~25,000 seats, expandable). Programming, schematic design, design development, construction documents, CA support. Coordinates with AOR (Arquitechtonica). 'Simple, but elegant' design.
MANICA.standard_of_care: Professional care among internationally recognized firms. Compared to 7 Comparable Facilities: Allianz Field, BMO Stadium, Exploria Stadium, TQL Stadium, Nashville Fairgrounds, Q2 Stadium, New Columbus Crew Stadium.
MANICA.insurance: WC stat+$1M, CGL $1M/$2M, Auto $1M, Prof Liab $5M/$5M (7 years post-completion), Excess $5M, Valuable Papers $1M. A:X Best's rating.
MANICA.indemnification: General (10.5): defends/indemnifies for negligent acts. Professional (10.6): for errors/omissions in professional services. Full extent permitted by law.
MANICA.termination: Convenience: 7 days notice, pays services rendered ONLY (no anticipated profit). Cause: 5 day cure. By architect: 30 days after non-payment or 365 day suspension.
MANICA.waiver_consequential: MUTUAL. Exceptions: breach of confidentiality or indemnification obligations.
MANICA.dispute_resolution: Binding AAA arbitration (Commercial/Construction). 11 arbitrators, each strikes 3, alternating until 1. Miami hearing within 30 days. No consequential/punitive damages. Each party bears own costs.
MANICA.ip_ownership: Developer owns ALL design documents, copyrights, IP in perpetuity. Architect has revocable license only during term.
notable: Work for hire — Developer owns all IP
Exculpation clause — Developer's members/officers no personal liability
Comparable Facilities defined (7 specific MLS stadiums)
BIM Execution Manual (Revit 2023, BIM 360)
CAA ICON was Developer's Representative
MANICA.exhibits: A (Program), A-1 (Legal), D (Schedule/Payment), E (Consultants), F (Hourly Rates), G (Basic Services), G-1 (Responsibility Matrix), H-1/H-2 (Liens), I (Social Media), J (BIM Manual), K (Line of Work)

ARQ_AOR.termination: Identical to MANICA: Convenience 7 days, Cause 5 days cure, by AOR 30 days non-payment or 365 day suspension.
